nodes.name: View Page (GET)
nodes.notes: GET /webhook/sop-view?sop_id=...&version=... Solo lectura: solo versiones publicadas.

nodes.name: Parse Query
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO: id seguro y versión numérica; si no, 400 sin tocar la base de datos.

parameters.query:
SELECT (SELECT to_jsonb(d) FROM sop_docs d WHERE d.sop_id = $1) AS doc,
  (SELECT to_jsonb(v) FROM sop_versions v WHERE v.sop_id = $1
     AND ((NULLIF($2, '') IS NULL AND v.status = 'published') OR (NULLIF($2, '') IS NOT NULL AND v.version = NULLIF($2, '')::int AND v.status IN ('published', 'superseded')))
   ORDER BY v.version DESC LIMIT 1) AS ver

nodes.name: Load SOP
nodes.notes: Documento y versión publicada (o ya reemplazada).

nodes.name: Render Page
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO: todo se escapa. Un borrador y un SOP inexistente dan la misma respuesta 404.

parameters.content:
## SOP · Published page
Read-only GET. Shows only published versions (or a superseded one, marked as such). A draft and an unknown id get the same 404.
